nodes.description: KittyInterface ck - external ERC721 CryptoKitties contract used for transfers and gene lookup
Destiny destiny - external battle-resolution contract called with cat genes and entropy
Game[] games - public array holding all arena game state (players, fightBlock, winner)
address constant TIE = address(-2) - sentinel winner value meaning the fight was a tie
enter(uint256 kitty) - pulls a kitty via transferFrom and seats it as player1 or player2
resolve(uint256 gameId) - public unrestricted function that computes the winner and transfers both kitties out
getWinner(uint256 gameId) view - derives entropy from block hash and asks Destiny who wins
catGenes(uint256 kitty) private view - reads kitty genes through ck.getKitty
Destiny.fight(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32) - external battle resolution entry point
KittyInterface.transferFrom(address,address,uint256) - external token pull used by enter()
KittyInterface.transfer(address,uint256) - external token push used by resolve()
KittyInterface.getKitty(uint256) - external view returning kitty attributes including genes
maxRandom(uint256 sourceBlock) view - returns blockhash(sourceBlock) as pseudo entropy
random(uint256 upper[,uint256 sourceBlock]) - pseudo random number modulo upper using chain data
bitSlice(uint256,uint256,uint256) pure - extracts a bit range via mask shifting
msg.sender - caller-supplied address used as kitty owner and transfer origin
kitty parameter of enter(uint256 kitty)
gameId parameter of resolve(uint256 gameId)
gameId parameter of getWinner(uint256 gameId)
kitty parameter of catGenes(uint256 kitty)
sourceBlock parameter of maxRandom(uint256 sourceBlock)
upper parameter of random(uint256 upper)
External call ck.transferFrom(msg.sender, this, kitty) performed before any game state update
External calls ck.transfer(...) executed for both kitties in resolve()
External call ck.getKitty(kitty) returning low-level returned values through var tuple destructuring
External call destiny.fight(genes1, genes2, seed) returning winner genes
block.blockhash(sourceBlock) - miner-influenceable pseudo randomness source
games.length += 1 - unchecked integer arithmetic on array length
block.number - 1 - unchecked integer arithmetic used as entropy source block
Game storage game local reference inside enter()
Player storage player local reference inside enter()
Game storage game local reference inside resolve()
Game storage game local reference inside getWinner()
bytes32 seed derived from maxRandom(game.fightBlock) in getWinner()
bytes32 winnerGenes returned by destiny.fight in getWinner()
bytes32 genes extracted from the ck.getKitty tuple in catGenes()

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the from argument of ck.transferFrom inside enter()
msg.sender is stored as Player.addr in the local player reference
msg.sender is the caller identity consumed by enter() to attribute the kitty
kitty parameter is written into the Game storage local reference
kitty parameter is packed into Player(kitty, msg.sender)
enter() performs an external call to the Kitty token before updating any game state, allowing re-entrant enter() calls
games.length += 1 is unchecked integer arithmetic that can overflow on extreme array growth
enter() reads and writes the games state array
resolve() delegates outcome computation to getWinner()
resolve() makes two external ck.transfer calls after settling the winner, exposing re-entrancy through a malicious token implementation
resolve() reads game state and writes game.winner in games
resolve() compares game.winner against the TIE constant to pick the recipient
gameId parameter indexes the games array into the local game reference
gameId parameter indexes the games array into the local game reference in getWinner()
getWinner() calls catGenes() for both players' kitties
getWinner() calls maxRandom(game.fightBlock) to derive entropy
getWinner() calls the external Destiny contract through destiny.fight()
the entropy returned by maxRandom is stored in the local seed variable
maxRandom() return value flows into the seed local variable
seed is passed as the entropy argument to destiny.fight
the bytes32 returned by destiny.fight is stored in winnerGenes
winnerGenes is compared with the two gene values to select the winner address
catGenes() returns bytes32 genes up into getWinner()
catGenes() calls the external ck.getKitty() view
kitty parameter is forwarded as the id argument of ck.getKitty
the genes field of the ck.getKitty return tuple is assigned to the local genes variable
the local genes value is returned from catGenes()
maxRandom() uses block.blockhash as its randomness primitive
sourceBlock parameter is provided to block.blockhash
random() calls maxRandom() to obtain the raw hash value
block.number - 1 is unchecked integer arithmetic used to pick the entropy block
upper parameter bounds the modulo result of random()
the ck.transferFrom operation resolves to the KittyInterface.transferFrom implementation
the ck.transfer operation resolves to the KittyInterface.transfer implementation
the ck.getKitty operation resolves to the KittyInterface.getKitty implementation
the destiny.fight operation resolves to the Destiny.fight implementation

normalization_plan.reason: kitty is the sole input parameter of enter() and has no independent security semantics
gameId only selects the game for resolve() and is consumed immediately
gameId only indexes the games array inside getWinner()
kitty is forwarded directly to ck.getKitty inside catGenes()
sourceBlock is only used as the block.blockhash argument in maxRandom()
upper is only used as the modulo bound inside random()
temporary storage alias for games[games.length-1] scoped to enter()
temporary storage alias for game.player1/player2 scoped to enter()
storage alias of games[gameId] scoped to resolve()
storage alias of games[gameId] scoped to getWinner()
seed exists only to be forwarded as entropy into destiny.fight
winnerGenes is the direct return value of the destiny.fight external call
genes is the extracted return value of ck.getKitty remapped by catGenes()
